authority.rule: image 03 controls front landmarks; images 06/07/08 remain mandatory depth/profile constraints

method.repeatability: identical measurements and pixel landmarks on immediate rerun

highConfidenceFindings.defect: candidate front face reads proportionally wider/shorter than canonical 03
highConfidenceFindings.recommendedAction: during MetaHuman conform, lengthen the facial vertical proportion or reduce upper/mid-face width while preserving eye-to-chin placement
highConfidenceFindings.automation: measure automatically; change requires human review

highConfidenceFindings.defect: candidate mouth is substantially too narrow relative to face
highConfidenceFindings.recommendedAction: widen lip corners conservatively after MetaHuman topology conform and retest neutral/lip-seal deformation
highConfidenceFindings.automation: measure automatically; sculpt/conform requires human review

highConfidenceFindings.defect: candidate nose base is too narrow relative to face
highConfidenceFindings.recommendedAction: increase alar/base width during conform while checking profiles 07/08 before keeping the change
highConfidenceFindings.automation: measure automatically; change requires profile review

lowConfidenceEyeFindings.reason: the candidate uses a visibly invalid prototype eye/iris assembly
lowConfidenceEyeFindings.decision: do not drive geometry from eye deltas until MetaHuman eyes and eyelid contact exist

excludedFinding.reason: canonical neutral lip opening is nearly zero, so relative percentage is numerically unstable

limitations: front 2D landmarks do not establish skull depth, nose projection or jaw profile
hair and camera projection can bias contour landmarks
the detector does not replace human identity approval
profiles 07 and 08 still require post-conform visual and geometric comparison

hypothesisForMetaHumanV002.statement: The largest front-identity mismatch comes from an overly wide/short face combined with a narrow mouth and nose base.
hypothesisForMetaHumanV002.action: conform to MetaHuman topology, then adjust face aspect, mouth width and nose base as separate reversible parameters.
hypothesisForMetaHumanV002.expectedResult: reduce the three front-landmark deltas without degrading images 06/07/08 profile agreement or facial deformation.
hypothesisForMetaHumanV002.decisionRule: keep each change only if fixed-view measurements improve and human side-by-side review agrees
